title: Kali Sing Ngungkap Ati
intro: Bayangna sawijining tentara sing lagi mlaku, ngelak lan diuji, ing ngendi mung siji komando ing pinggir kali bakal misahake tekad lan kepinginan. Pemimpin sing dipilih nuntun barisan menyang mungsuh sing kuat, kanthi nggawa kepercayaan marang Allah SWT.
clues: Aku diangkat dening Allah dadi pamimpin kanggo Bani Israil sawise wong-wong mau njaluk wong sing arep perang ing dalane-Ne.
Aku diparingi kawruh lan status sing akeh minangka tandha pilihanku, sanajan bangsaku mangu-mangu panguwasaku.
Aku budhal karo pasukan lan ngandhani yen Allah bakal nguji dheweke nganggo kali.
Aku wis ngelingake yen sapa wae sing ngombe saka iku kanthi bebas, dheweke ora kalebu golonganku, kajaba wong sing nyendok segenggam.
Aku nyebrang karo sawetara wong sing tetep teguh, ngadhepi tentara sing luwih akeh cacahe.
Aku mimpin wong-wong sing ngomong sepira kerepe pasukan cilik bisa ngalahake pasukan gedhe kanthi idin saka Allah, sadurunge Jalut dikalahake.

trial.label: Uji Coba/Acara
options: Nguji tentara nganggo kali sadurunge perang
trial.answer: Nguji tentara nganggo kali sadurunge perang

outcome.label: Asil
options: Kemenangan atas izin Allah lan Jalut tiwas dening Dawud
Kecemplung ing segara karo sing duwe omah
outcome.answer: Kemenangan atas izin Allah lan Jalut tiwas dening Dawud

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
